title: Fix Issues with Modules: BUYING, SELLING, STOCK, CRM

posts.cooked:
Hi there!

Could you please help to fix this messages in the ERPNext. We are the admin role but this message appears in the modules: BUYING, SELLING, STOCK, CRM.

BUYING: You don’t have access to Report: Purchase Order Trends

SELLING: You don’t have permission to get a report on: Sales Order

STOCK: User username**@xxxx.sv** does not have doctype access via role permission for document Bin

No permission for Bin

CRM: User username**@xxxx.sv** does not have doctype access via role permission for document Opportunity

No permission for Opportunity

Thanks in advance!

posts.name: Nikitadattapawar06
posts.cooked:
1. Open Role Permission Manager in Frappe.
  2. Search for the Doctype you currently do not have access to.
  3. Add the required permissions such as Read, Write, Select, etc., according to your needs.
  4. Reload and check the issue still persist.

Dear Nikita,

I appreciate your support and advices.

It will take some time for us to become familiar with the functionality of the system. ERPNext is a powerful tool, and we chose it because it meets all the necessary modules we need.

Do not you mind to explain if ERPNext has only this Forum for Q&A or live chat, phone numbers or emails are available?

Many thanks!
